question: Pregnancy me khoon (hemoglobin) badhane ke liye kya khana chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein hemoglobin ke liye **iron-rich foods** roz khayein aur unke saath **Vitamin C** wali cheez lein.

- **Iron foods:** palak/methi jaise leafy vegetables, dal, chana, rajma/beans, bajra, jowar, til, pumpkin seeds, khajoor aur kishmish.
- Agar aap non-veg khati hain: anda, chicken, fish aur lean meat le sakti hain.
- **Vitamin C saath mein:** nimbu, amla, amrood, orange, tomato ya capsicum. Jaise dal/chana par nimbu nichod sakti hain.

**Iron absorb hone ke liye:**
- Chai, coffee aur cola ko iron-rich meal ya iron tablet ke aas-paas na lein; kam se kam **1–2 ghante ka gap** rakhein.
- Milk/curd ya calcium supplements ko iron tablet ke same time par na lein; alag time par lein.

Sirf khane se significant anemia hamesha theek nahi hota. Pregnancy mein prescribed **Iron-Folic Acid (IFA)** tablets lena aur Hb test karwana zaroori ho sakta hai—tablet ki dose apne doctor/health worker se confirm karein.

Agar bahut zyada kamzori, chakkar, saans phoolna, dhadkan tez hona, behoshi, ya Hb bahut kam ho, to jaldi health facility se sampark karein.
Topics: Pregnancy anemia, Antenatal nutrition, Iron and folic acid supplementation

question: Pregnancy me khoon ki jaanch (blood test) karana kyu zaroori hai?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein blood tests isliye zaroori hote hain kyunki inse maa aur baby ko affect karne wali problems **jaldi pakdi** ja sakti hain.

In tests se doctor/health worker check kar sakte hain:
- **Khoon ki kami (anaemia)** aur platelet level
- **Blood group aur Rh factor**, jisse Rh-related risk ka plan ban sake
- **Blood sugar**, yani pregnancy diabetes ka risk
- Kuch infections, jaise **HIV, syphilis aur hepatitis B**; dusre tests local guidelines aur aapki health history ke hisaab se ho sakte hain
- Zarurat par **thyroid** ya anya health problems

Early detection se iron/folic acid, medicines, vaccination, monitoring ya referral jaise steps time par liye ja sakte hain. Kaun-sa test aur kab repeat hoga, yeh aapke trimester, reports, risk factors aur doctor/health worker ki advice par depend karta hai.

question: Iron aur Calcium ki goliyaan ek saath le sakte hain ya nahi? Unhe kab lena chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
**Iron aur calcium ki goli ek saath na lein**, kyunki calcium iron ke absorption ko kam kar sakta hai.

- **Calcium:** aam taur par meal ke baad le sakte hain, agar doctor ne prescribe kiya ho.
- **Iron/IFA:** calcium se **kam se kam 2 ghante ka gap** rakhkar lein. Pet par suit kare to meals ke beech/baad le sakte hain.
- Iron tablet ke aas-paas **chai, coffee, ya doodh** lene se bachna behtar hai, kyunki iron absorption kam ho sakta hai.

Example: calcium breakfast aur dinner ke baad, aur iron/IFA lunch ke lagbhag 2 ghante baad. Dose aur exact timing apne doctor ki prescription ke mutabik rakhein—khaaskar agar Hb kam hai, pregnancy hai, ya doosri medicines chal rahi hain.

question: Pregnancy me BP (Blood Pressure) badh jaaye to kya karna chahiye? Yeh khatarnak kyu hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pregnancy mein BP badh jaaye to kya karein?

Pregnancy mein high BP ko **ignore na karein**. Aaj hi apne doctor/ANM/health centre se baat karein aur antenatal check-up miss na karein. BP, urine test aur baby ki growth/movement ki assessment zaroori ho sakti hai. **Khud se BP ki dawa shuru, band ya dose change na karein.**

### Turant hospital/health facility jaayein agar high BP ke saath:
- tez ya lagatar headache, chakkar, ya aankhon ke saamne dhundhla dikhna ho
- chehre ya haathon mein achanak zyada sujan ho
- pet ke upar/right side mein tez dard, saans phoolna, behoshi ya bahut zyada kamzori ho
- vaginal bleeding ya paani jaisa discharge ho
- baby ki movement kam ya band lage

Transport na mile to local emergency/ambulance service, jaise **102/108** (jahaan available ho), ko call karein.

### Yeh khatarnak kyun ho sakta hai?
Pregnancy ka high BP kabhi-kabhi **preeclampsia** naam ki serious condition ka sign hota hai. Isse maa ko fits (seizures), stroke, kidney/liver problems ya placenta se judi complications ka risk ho sakta hai. Baby tak blood aur oxygen ki supply kam ho sakti hai, jisse growth kam hona, time se pehle delivery, ya doosri serious problems ho sakti hain. Jaldi check-up aur treatment se risk kam kiya ja sakta hai.

Agar possible ho, BP reading, pregnancy ke kitne weeks/months hain, aur koi symptom hai ya nahi, yeh doctor ko batayein.

question: Pregnancy me TT (Tetanus) ka tika kab aur kitni baar lagta hai?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein tetanus se bachav ke liye **Td/TT vaccine** aam taur par lagti hai:

- **Dose 1:** Pregnancy ka pata chalne ke baad, **jaldi se jaldi**.
- **Dose 2:** Pehli dose ke **kam se kam 4 hafton baad**.
- Dono doses ko ideally **pregnancy ke 36 weeks se pehle** complete karna chahiye.

Agar aapko pichhle **3 saal mein 2 tetanus-containing doses** lag chuki hain, to aksar **1 booster dose** hi kaafi hoti hai.

Apna **MCP/vaccination card** ANM ya doctor ko zaroor dikhayein, kyunki exact schedule aapke purane vaccination record par depend karta hai. Government health facilities mein yeh vaccine aam taur par free milti hai.

question: Mera bachcha kamzor paida hua hai aur use 'kaanch' (incubator) me rakha hai. Iska kya matlab hai?
CompiledAnswer:
“Kaanch” se aam taur par **incubator** matlab hota hai—ek hospital machine/bed jo chhote ya kamzor newborn ko garam rakhne aur close monitoring ke liye use hoti hai.

Baby ko incubator mein **kam birth weight, time se pehle paida hone, body temperature maintain na kar paane, saans ki problem, feeding difficulty, ya infection ke risk** ki wajah se rakha ja sakta hai. Sirf incubator mein rakhne ka matlab yeh nahi ki baby ki condition zaroor bahut serious hai; exact reason treating doctor hi bata sakte hain.

Doctor/nurse se poochhein:
- Baby ka birth weight aur pregnancy ke kitne weeks par birth hua?
- Incubator ki zarurat ka main reason kya hai—weight, saans, temperature, feeding, ya koi aur problem?
- Baby ko breastmilk kaise aur kab diya jayega?

Agar baby stable ho, hospital team **Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC)**—maa ya pita ke seene se skin-to-skin contact—and breastmilk ki salah de sakti hai. Yeh **hospital staff ki advice ke mutabik** hi shuru karein.

Hospital mein baby ki saans tez/chalti hui lage, baby neela pade, feed na le, bahut sust ho, ya bukhar/temperature low ho, to turant nurse ya doctor ko batayein.

question: Doctor ne bataya hai ki bachche ka vajan kam hai aur paani ki bhi kami hai. Ab kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pehle yeh clear karna zaroori hai
“Bachche ka vajan kam aur paani ki kami” ka matlab do alag situations ho sakta hai:

1. **Pregnancy mein ultrasound par baby ka weight kam aur paani/amniotic fluid kam**, ya
2. **Paida hue bachche ka weight kam aur dehydration/feeding ki kami**.

Dono mein doctor ki **jaldi follow-up review** zaroori hai. Scan/report ya child growth record saath le jaiye.

## Agar aap pregnant hain
- Gynaecologist se poochhiye ki baby ka growth, amniotic fluid aur placenta report mein kya likha hai aur next scan/monitoring kab hai.
- Doctor ki batayi medicines, iron-folic acid/calcium aur diet advice follow karein; bina advice ke koi medicine ya home remedy se “paani” badhane ki koshish na karein.
- **Turant facility jaiye** agar bleeding ya paani jaisa discharge, tez pet dard, bukhar, behoshi/zyada kamzori, severe headache, chehre/haath-pair ki achanak sujan, ya baby ki movements kam/na ho.

## Agar bachcha paida ho chuka hai
- Child doctor/health worker se **weight, feeding/latch, urine output aur growth chart** check karwaiye.
- Breastfeeding baby ko **baar-baar breastfeed** karaiye. 6 mahine se chhote baby ko aam taur par sirf breastmilk chahiye; plain paani ya koi drink dene se pehle doctor se poochhein.
- Low-birth-weight lekin stable baby ke liye **Kangaroo Mother Care** (skin-to-skin contact aur frequent exclusive breastfeeding) helpful ho sakta hai.
- Dast/ulti ho to feeding band na karein; ORS ya fluids ke baare mein health worker ki salah lein.

**Urgent care lein** agar bachcha feed na kar raha ho, bahut sust ho, baar-baar ulti/dast ho, muh sookha ho, aankhen dhansi lagen, bukhar ho, ya peshab bahut kam ho.

Doctor ko bachche ki age/pregnancy week, current weight, kitne din se problem hai, feeding aur urine ki details, aur scan/report dikhaiye.

question: Bachchon ke liye teekakaran (vaccination) kyu zaroori hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Bachchon ke liye vaccination kyu zaroori hai?

Vaccination bachche ko kai **serious infectious diseases** se bachane ka safe aur effective tareeqa hai. Vaccine body ke immune system ko infection pehchanne aur uske khilaaf protection (antibodies aur immune response) banane mein madad karta hai.

- Vaccines sahi umar par aur **poori recommended doses** mein lagne par best protection dete hain.
- Vaccine delay ya miss hone par bachcha kuch samay tak us bimari se kam protected reh sakta hai aur serious infection ka risk badh sakta hai.
- Teekakaran se kuch bimariyon ki severe complications, hospital admission aur death ka risk kam hota hai.
- Routine childhood vaccination birth se shuru hoti hai. India mein sarkari health facilities par National Immunization Schedule ke vaccines aam taur par free milte hain; Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card sambhal kar rakhein.

Agar koi dose miss ho gayi ho, apne nearest health centre ya pediatrician se catch-up vaccination ke baare mein poochhein.

question: Agar maa ka doodh bachche ke liye kam pad raha ho to kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
Aksar doodh sach mein kam nahi hota—pehle dekhein ki baby ko milk theek se mil raha hai ya nahi.

- Baby ko **demand par baar-baar breastfeed** karayein, din aur raat mein. Har feed mein baby ko ek breast par tab tak peene dein jab tak woh khud chhod de, phir zarurat ho to doosra breast offer karein.
- **Latch check karein:** baby ka muh wide open ho, chin breast ko touch kare, aur nipple ke saath areola ka kaafi hissa muh mein ho. Feed ke dauran gehri sucking aur nigalne ki awaaz/harakat dikhni chahiye.
- Agar baby 5 din se bada aur exclusively breastfed hai, to aam taur par **24 ghante mein 6 ya zyada wet diapers/urine** aur lagatar weight gain reassuring signs hote hain. Growth ko health worker ke growth chart par check karwana sabse behtar hai.
- Pehle 6 mahine mein, agar baby sirf breastfeed kar raha hai, to **paani, ghutti ya doosra feed** na dein; pyas/feeding cues par breast offer karein.

**Jaldi doctor, ANM/ASHA, ya lactation counsellor se milen** agar baby bahut sust ho, feed na kar raha ho, urine bahut kam ho, weight na badh raha ho/ghat raha ho, bukhar ho, ya dehydration ke signs hon. Baby ki umar, wet diapers ki sankhya, weight trend aur latch dekhkar hi pata chalega ki supply ki problem hai ya feeding technique ki.

question: Garbhavastha me bachche ka vajan badhane ke liye maa ko kya khana chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Garbhavastha mein baby ki healthy growth ke liye kya khayen?

Baby ka weight sirf khane se nahi, balki pregnancy ke month, maa ke Hb/BP/sugar, placenta aur anya health factors se bhi affect hota hai. Isliye **balanced diet** lein—sirf zyada khana zaroori nahi.

- Roz **4–5 chhote, nutritious meals** lein. Dusre trimester se ek extra healthy meal/snack le sakti hain.
- Har din protein shamil karein: **dal, chana, rajma, beans, doodh, dahi, paneer, anda**; non-veg lete hain to well-cooked fish/chicken.
- **Roti/rice, bajra, jowar, ragi** jaise grains, seasonal fruits aur sabziyan—khaaskar hari pattedar sabziyan—khaayen.
- Healthy snacks: fruit, doodh, peanuts/nuts, roasted chana, dates ya salad.
- Iron ke liye dal, chana, leafy vegetables aur jaggery/dates; calcium ke liye doodh, dahi, paneer lein. **Iodized namak** use karein.
- Doctor/ANM ne jo **iron-folic acid (IFA) aur calcium tablets** di hain, unhe unki salah ke mutabik lein. Iron aur calcium ko ek saath na lein; tea/coffee bhi meals ya iron tablet ke aas-paas na lein.
- Paani aur anya safe fluids milakar lagbhag **2 litre ya pyaas ke hisaab se** lein, agar doctor ne fluid restriction na di ho.

**Bachna chahiye:** junk/zyada oily ya sugary food, alcohol, tobacco/gutkha, kaccha ya adhpaka anda, aur bina ubla/pasteurized doodh. Tea/coffee ko limited rakhein.

Agar ultrasound mein baby ka weight kam, growth slow, ya paani/BP/sugar/Hb ki problem batayi gayi hai, to apni pregnancy week aur ultrasound report ke saath doctor se jaldi personal advice lein.

question: Paida hone ke baad bachche ko kaun se teeke kab-kab lagte hain?
CompiledAnswer:
## Bharat mein routine teekakaran schedule

Bachche ka routine vaccination **janm ke samay** shuru hota hai. Vaccination card sambhal kar rakhein aur due date par session/site par jaayein.

| Umar | Routine teeke / drops |
|---|---|
| **Janm par** | **BCG**, **Hepatitis-B birth dose** (behtar hai 24 ghante ke andar), **OPV-0** polio drops |
| **6 hafte** | OPV-1, Pentavalent-1, Rotavirus-1, fractional IPV-1 |
| **10 hafte** | OPV-2, Pentavalent-2, Rotavirus-2 |
| **14 hafte** | OPV-3, Pentavalent-3, Rotavirus-3, fractional IPV-2 |
| **9–12 mahine** | MR/Measles-Rubella pehla dose, Vitamin A pehla dose; **JE-1** sirf JE-endemic districts mein |
| **16–24 mahine** | DPT booster-1, OPV booster, MR/Measles-Rubella doosra dose, Vitamin A; **JE-2** selected endemic districts mein |
| **5–6 saal** | DPT booster-2 |
| **10 aur 16 saal** | **Td** vaccine |

Vitamin A ki agali doses aam taur par har 6 mahine mein 5 saal ki umar tak di jaati hain. Government health facilities par routine vaccines free milte hain.

Agar koi teeka miss ho gaya ho, card lekar nearest health facility par jaayein—schedule dobara shuru karne ki zarurat aam taur par nahi hoti.

question: Pregnancy ke dauran kaun se khatre ke lakshan (danger signs) hain jinhe nazarandaaz nahi karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pregnancy mein danger signs

Pregnancy mein in lakshanon ko **bilkul ignore na karein**. Inmein se koi bhi ho to **turant doctor/nearest health centre se sampark karein**:

- Vaginal bleeding, ya paani jaisa fluid **leak** hona
- Tez ya lagataar pet dard
- Tez sar dard, chakkar, dhundhla dikhna, ya chehre/haathon ki achanak soojan
- Fits/daure, behoshi, bahut zyada kamzori, ya saans lene mein dikkat
- Bukhar ya kapkapi
- Baby ki harkat pehle se kam lagna ya bilkul band lagna
- Tez ulti jisse khana-paani na ruk paaye
- Bahut zyada peela pan, thakaan, ya severe anaemia ke lakshan
- Raat mein dekhne mein dikkat (night blindness)

**Agar bleeding zyada ho, fits aaye, saans ki dikkat ho, tez pet dard ho, ya baby ki movement kam/band ho, to emergency care abhi lein.**

question: Normal delivery ke liye kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Normal delivery ke liye kya taiyari karein?

“Normal” (vaginal) delivery ki guarantee nahi hoti—maa aur baby ki condition dekhkar doctor/ANM safe delivery method decide karte hain. Safe vaginal delivery ki preparation ke liye:

- Pregnancy ko jaldi register karayein aur **saari scheduled ANC check-ups** karayein.
- Doctor/ANM ki salah se **IFA (iron-folic acid), calcium aur doosri prescribed medicines** lein. Iron aur calcium ko aam taur par alag samay par lena behtar hota hai.
- Poshtik khana khayein, paryapt paani aur aaram lein; tobacco, gutkha, bidi, alcohol aur drugs bilkul na lein.
- **Birth plan** banayein: delivery kahan karani hai, saath kaun rahega, transport, emergency paise aur zarurat par blood donor contact.
- Delivery bag ready rakhein: MCP card, ID/Aadhaar, blood/ultrasound reports, kapde, sanitary/hygiene items aur baby ke kapde.
- Labour shuru ho, paani nikle, ya koi problem lage to health centre/hospital se turant sampark karein. Ambulance ke liye apne area ka **102/108** number verify karke rakhein.

**Turant hospital jayein** agar vaginal bleeding, paani nikalna, tez ya lagatar pet dard/contractions, baby ki movement kam lagna, severe headache, dhundhla dikhna, chehre/haath-pair mein achanak sujan, bukhar, behoshi ya saans ki dikkat ho.

Agar pehle C-section hua hai, BP/diabetes/anaemia hai, twins hain, ya doctor ne high-risk bataya hai, to delivery hospital aur referral plan pehle se confirm karein.

question: Pregnancy me kaun se phal aur sabziyan khani chahiye aur kaun si nahi?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pregnancy mein kya khayein
Pregnancy mein **fresh, seasonal aur achchhi tarah dhoye hue phal aur sabziyan** roz khayein. Plate ko colourful/rainbow rakhein aur phal-sabzi ke saath dal, beans, whole grains, milk/curd (agar suit kare) aur nuts bhi lein.

**Achchhe options:**
- **Hari sabziyan:** palak, methi, cabbage, broccoli, dhaniya
- **Anya sabziyan:** bhindi, gajar, tamatar, matar, beans
- **Phal:** amrood, santara/mosambi, nimbu, amla, seb, kela

Palak, dal aur beans jaise iron wale foods ke saath **vitamin-C wale phal/sabzi**—jaise amrood, santara, nimbu, amla ya tamatar—lene se iron absorb hone mein madad milti hai.

## Kis cheez se bachna ya limit karna hai
Aam taur par koi specific fruit ya vegetable sabke liye mana nahi hota, lekin **unwashed, sade/gale hue, ya hygienically prepare na kiye hue** phal-sabzi na khayein. Phal aur sabzi ko saaf paani se achchhi tarah dho kar, phir kaatkar khayein; soap ya detergent use na karein.

Saath hi pregnancy mein:
- Junk/packet food, bahut zyada namak, cheeni ya tel wali cheezein limit karein.
- Alcohol, tobacco, gutkha aur drugs bilkul na lein.
- Kachcha ya aadha paka anda aur bina ubla/pasteurised doodh na lein.
- Chai/coffee ko lagbhag **2 cups/day tak** rakhein aur meals ke turant saath na lein, kyunki iron absorption kam ho sakta hai.

Agar diabetes, severe vomiting, food allergy, anemia, high BP, ya koi pregnancy complication hai, to diet apne doctor/dietitian se personalise karwayein.

question: Maa ko achha doodh aaye, iske liye kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Maa ka doodh paryapt aane ke liye

Aksar “achha doodh” se matlab doodh ki **quantity/supply** hoti hai. Doodh banne ka sabse effective tareeqa hai baby ko sahi latch ke saath **jaldi aur baar-baar breastfeed** karana.

- Baby ko bhookh ke early signs—haath munh mein lena, breast ki taraf mudna, lips lick karna—par feed karayein; rone ka wait na karein.
- 24 ghante mein, raat mila kar, aam taur par **8–12 feeds** karayein.
- **Deep latch** zaroori hai: baby ka munh wide open ho, chin breast ko touch kare, aur areola ka zyada hissa munh mein ho. Feed bahut dardnaak nahi honi chahiye.
- Baby ko pehla breast khud chhodne dein; phir bhi bhookh lage to doosra breast offer karein.
- Skin-to-skin contact aur rooming-in feeding ko support karte hain.
- Pehle 6 mahine baby ko sirf breastmilk dein—paani, ghutti ya doosre fluids ki zaroorat nahi hoti, garmi mein bhi nahi.

### Doodh paryapt mil raha hai ya nahi?
Aam taur par day 5 ke baad baby 24 ghante mein **kam se kam 6 baar urine** kare aur weight theek se badhe. Weight ko regular growth monitoring se check karwana best hai.

Agar baby bahut sust ho, urine kam ho, feed na kar pa raha ho, weight na badh raha ho, ya maa ko nipple pain, cracked nipples, breast redness/fever, ya latch problem ho, to jaldi lactation counsellor/health worker/doctor se milen.

question: Caesarean (operation) se delivery ke baad khane-peene me kya parhez karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
### C-section ke baad khane-peene ka parhez
C-section ke baad aam taur par kisi specific food ya drink ko sabke liye strictly avoid karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Hospital/doctor ne jo diet instructions di hain, unhe zaroor follow karein.

- Recovery aur breastfeeding ke liye **protein aur balanced diet** lein—dal, pulses, eggs/milk (agar lete hain), whole grains aur sabziyan.
- **Paani aur fluids** achhi matra mein lein; aam taur par **2 litre se zyada/day** fluids helpful hote hain, agar doctor ne fluid restriction na di ho.
- **Fibre-rich foods**—whole grains, dal, fruits aur vegetables—constipation se bachane mein madad karte hain.
- Doctor ne prescribe kiya ho to **iron-folic acid tablets** regular lein.
- Breastfeeding ke pehle 6 mahine mein extra calories aur protein ki zaroorat badh sakti hai.

question: Pregnancy ke pehle 3 mahino me kaun se check-up karana zaroori hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pregnancy ke pehle 3 mahine (0–12 weeks) mein

Pregnancy confirm hote hi **jaldi registration** karayein aur **pehla antenatal check-up (ANC)** doctor, government hospital, ya health centre par karayein—behtar hai **12 weeks ke andar**.

### Pehli visit mein aam taur par
- **Blood pressure, weight** aur general health check
- **Urine test:** sugar, protein aur zarurat par infection ke liye
- **Blood tests:** hemoglobin/CBC (anaemia), blood group aur Rh factor, blood sugar, aur local programme ke hisaab se HIV, syphilis (VDRL), hepatitis B etc.
- Doctor aapki history ke hisaab se **thyroid, hepatitis C, rubella** ya doosre tests bhi suggest kar sakte hain.

### Ultrasound
Ultrasound ki timing aur zarurat doctor batate hain. Early scan pregnancy ki location/viability ya dates check karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai; routine dating/first-trimester scan aksar **11–14 weeks** ke aas-paas advise hota hai, local guidance aur clinical need ke anusaar.

### Supplements aur vaccines
- **Folic acid** ke baare mein turant poochhein; yeh early pregnancy mein khaas important hota hai.
- **Iron, calcium aur tetanus-diphtheria (Td) vaccine** ka schedule aapki health, pehle ke vaccination record aur local programme ke hisaab se health worker/doctor batayenge.

**Turant medical help lein** agar bleeding, ek taraf ya bahut tez pet dard, behoshi/chakkar, bukhar, severe vomiting/dehydration, ya fluid discharge ho.

question: Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) kya hai aur yeh kam vajan wale bachchon ke liye kyu zaroori hai?
CompiledAnswer:
**Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC)** premature ya **kam janm-vajan (low-birth-weight)** wale newborns ki ek proven care method hai. Ismein baby ko diaper aur cap ke saath maa ke bare chest par seedha, skin-to-skin rakha jata hai. Maa ke alawa healthy adult caregiver bhi KMC de sakta/sakti hai.

KMC mein aam taur par:
- jitna possible ho utna **lamba skin-to-skin contact**,
- **maa ka doodh** baar-baar dena (exclusive breastfeeding ko support karna), aur
- baby ki feeding, temperature aur growth ki monitoring shamil hoti hai.

**Yeh zaroori kyun hai?**
- Baby ko garam rakhne mein madad karta hai.
- Breastfeeding aur weight gain ko support karta hai.
- Breathing aur heart rate ko stable rakhne mein madad kar sakta hai.
- Infection ka risk aur serious complications kam karne mein madad karta hai.
- Maa-baby bonding badhata hai aur hospital se ghar jaane ke baad bhi care continue karne mein helpful hota hai.

KMC hospital/health worker ki salah se shuru karein, khaaskar agar baby bahut chhota, premature, ya beemar ho. Caregiver haath saaf rakhe aur saaf kapde pehne. Baby doodh na pee raha ho, saans tez/pareshan ho, bukhar ya thanda sharir ho, ya bahut sust lage, to turant health worker se sampark karein.

question: Paida hone ke baad pehla gaadha peela doodh (colostrum) bachche ke liye kyu amrit jaisa hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Colostrum baby ke liye “amrit” kyun hai?

Paida hone ke baad aane wala pehla gaadha peela doodh **colostrum** kehlata hai. Yeh quantity mein kam hota hai, lekin newborn ki zaroorat ke hisaab se bahut concentrated aur faydemand hota hai.

- Ismein infection se bachane wale **antibodies aur protective factors** hote hain—isi liye ise baby ki **pehli natural vaccine jaisi protection** kaha jata hai.
- Yeh protein, Vitamin A aur doosre important nutrients se bharpoor hota hai.
- Yeh baby ko pehla kaala/green stool (**meconium**) pass karne mein madad karta hai.
- Meconium jaldi nikalne se **jaundice ka risk kam karne mein madad** mil sakti hai.
- Yeh baby ke pet aur immunity ko breastfeeding ke liye tayyar karta hai.

Maa aur baby stable/ready hon to delivery ke **pehle 1 ghante ke andar breastfeeding shuru** karna aur colostrum zaroor pilana achha hota hai. Is pehle doodh ko na nikaalein aur na phenkain.

question: Bachche ko 6 mahine tak sirf maa ka doodh hi kyu pilana chahiye, paani bhi kyu nahi?
CompiledAnswer:
For a healthy, full-term baby aged under 6 months, **sirf maa ka doodh (exclusive breastfeeding)** dena recommended hai—**paani, ghutti, honey, animal milk, other liquids, ya food ki zarurat nahi hoti**.

### Paani kyun nahi?
- **Breast milk mein baby ke liye enough water hota hai**, garmi ke mausam mein bhi.
- Baar-baar breastfeeding se baby ki pyaas aur nutrition dono poore hote hain.
- Paani dene se baby ka pet bhar sakta hai, jis se woh kam breastfeed karega aur zaroori calories/nutrition kam mil sakte hain.
- Saaf na hua paani infection aur loose motions ka risk badha sakta hai.

Baby ko pyaas lage, dry lips dikhen, ya garmi ho to **paani dene ke bajay breast zyada baar offer karein**, din aur raat feed on demand karein.

**Exception:** Doctor/health worker ki salah par medicines, vitamins, ya special fluids diye ja sakte hain. Premature, low-birth-weight, ya medically unwell baby ke feeding plan ke liye doctor se poochhein.

question: Bachche ko 6 mahine ke baad upari aahar (solid food) dena kab aur kaise shuru karein?
CompiledAnswer:
## 6 mahine poore hone ke baad upari aahar kaise shuru karein

Healthy, full-term bachche ko **6 mahine poore hote hi** breastmilk ke saath complementary/solid food dena shuru kiya ja sakta hai. Breastfeeding on demand jaari rakhein; ise 2 saal ya usse zyada tak continue kiya ja sakta hai.

- Shuruat **gaadhe, smooth mashed/pureed ya semi-solid** khane se karein—patla pani jaisa dalia/gruel na dein.
- Pehle **2–3 chammach**, din mein **2–3 baar** dein. Bachcha accept kare to quantity dheere-dheere badhayein.
- Achhe options: mashed khichdi ya dal-chawal, mashed kela/papaya/aam, paka hua mashed aloo ya shakarkand, ragi, idli ya dalia.
- Saaf katori aur chammach se, dheere aur pyaar se khilayein. Bachche ko encourage karein, par **zabardasti na khilayein**. Feeding ke waqt TV/mobile se bachayein.
- Haath sabun se dhokar khana banayein aur khilayein; taza khana aur saaf bartan use karein. Solid food ke liye feeding bottle use na karein.
- Whole nuts, poore angoor aur kacche gajar ke tukde na dein, kyunki choking ka risk hota hai. Nuts dene hon to unhe barik peeskar khane mein milayein.
- Biscuits, cakes, packaged/canned foods, juice, bahut meethi cereals aur baar-baar tale hue foods se bachein.

Lagbhag **8 mahine** par mashed, barik kata hua aur safe finger food shuru kiya ja sakta hai. **12 mahine** tak kai bachche mashed/chopped family food kha sakte hain.

*Yeh general salah healthy, full-term, lagbhag 6 mahine ke bachche ke liye hai. Agar bachcha premature hai, weight/growth ki dikkat hai, ya khana nigalne mein problem hoti hai, to pediatrician se salah lein.*

question: Pregnancy ke dauran sarkari yojana (PMMVY) se paise kaise mil sakte hain?
CompiledAnswer:
## PMMVY mein paise kaise milte hain?

PMMVY (Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana) ke liye nearest **Anganwadi Centre** ya government health facility par registration karayein. **ASHA worker, ANM/nurse ya Anganwadi worker** form bharne mein madad kar sakte hain.

1. Pregnancy registration karayein aur **PMMVY Form 1-A** submit karein.
2. **Aadhaar-linked bank ya post-office account** ki details dein, taki paisa DBT se account mein aa sake.
3. Aadhaar, bank/post-office passbook, pregnancy/MCP card aur jo eligibility proof maanga jaye woh le kar jaayein.
4. Pehle living child ke liye benefit aam taur par **₹5,000** hota hai: registration aur ANC ke baad ek hissa, aur birth registration plus 14-week vaccination ke baad baaki hissa.
5. Doosre child ke case mein, agar baby girl ho, to alag benefit provision ho sakta hai.

Eligibility aur required documents state/portal ke current rules ke hisaab se badal sakte hain. Isliye apne Anganwadi worker ya nearest government health facility se **current eligibility, installment amount aur documents** confirm zaroor karein. Regular salary/maternity benefit paane wali government employees aam taur par eligible nahi hoti hain.

India ke government health facilities mein garbhvati mahilaon aur bachchon ke liye kai services muft milti hain. Facility aur state ke hisaab se availability thodi alag ho sakti hai.

### Garbhvati mahilaon ke liye
**JSSK ke tahat** aam taur par yeh services free hoti hain:
- Normal delivery aur C-section delivery
- Delivery ke dauran medicines, zaroori consumables/materials aur tests
- Blood/urine jaise tests aur available diagnostic tests
- Hospital mein khana: normal delivery ke baad aam taur par **3 din** aur C-section ke baad **7 din** tak
- Ghar se hospital, referral hospital aur discharge ke baad ghar tak transport/ambulance, jahan service available ho
- Delivery se judi hospital fees nahi li jaati

### Pregnancy check-up aur supplements
- **PMSMA** ke under har mahine ki **9 tareekh** ko designated facilities par free ANC/pregnancy check-up
- Iron-folic acid (IFA), calcium tablets aur **Td (Tetanus-Diphtheria)** vaccine/injection, doctor ki salah aur stock ke hisaab se

### Bachchon ke liye
- **1 saal se chhote beemar bachche** ke liye admission/treatment, medicines, tests, hospital meals aur transport JSSK ke under free ho sakte hain.
- National Immunization Schedule ke routine vaccines free hote hain.
- Vaccine ke liye syringe aur Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card bhi free milte hain.

Ambulance ke liye kai jagah **102** ya **108** par call kiya ja sakta hai, lekin number aur service state ke hisaab se badal sakti hai. Apne nearest sarkari hospital/PHC se service timing aur availability confirm kar lein.

question: Bachche ko teeka lagne ke baad bukhar ya soojan aaye to kya karna chahiye?

question: Pregnancy me kamar aur pet ke nichle hisse me dard kyu hota hai? Kab chinta karni chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein **halka, kabhi-kabhi hone wala kamar ya pet ke neeche dard** body ke badlav, uterus ke badhne, muscles/ligaments par khinchav, posture change, ya thakan ki wajah se ho sakta hai. Lekin bina check-up ke exact reason batana possible nahi hai.

**Turant doctor/health centre se baat karein ya urgent care lein** agar dard:

- **Tez, achanak, ya lagataar** ho
- **Bleeding/spotting** ke saath ho
- Vagina se **pani jaisa fluid/discharge** aaye
- **Bukhar ya kapkapi** ho
- **Chakkar, behoshi, bahut kamzori**, severe headache, ya face/hands/feet mein zyada sujan ho
- Baby ki movement pehle mehsoos hoti thi aur ab **kam ya band** lage
- Peshab mein jalan, baar-baar peshab, ya kamar ke ek taraf bahut tez dard ho

Agar dard halka hai aur koi warning sign nahi hai, heavy lifting aur bahut mehnat se bachein, aaram karein, aur apne antenatal check-up mein zaroor batayein. **Severe ya persistent pain ko normal samajhkar ignore na karein.**

Doctor ko sahi guidance ke liye batayein: aap kitne weeks/months pregnant hain, dard kab se hai, kitna tez hai, aur bleeding, discharge, fever, peshab mein jalan, ya baby movement mein koi change hai ya nahi.

question: Pregnancy me pairon me soojan (swelling) aana normal hai ya nahi?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein **pairon/ankles ki halki, dheere-dheere badhne wali soojan**—khaaskar din ke end ya pregnancy ke aakhri mahino mein—aksar ho sakti hai. Lekin ise bina check kiye hamesha normal bhi na maanein.

- achanak ya bahut zyada ho,

- severe headache, dhundhla dikhna, chakkar, pet ke upar wale hissa mein dard, saans phoolna, ya BP high ke saath ho,

Routine antenatal check-up mein **BP aur urine** check karwana zaroori hai. Tab tak lambi der khade rehne se bachein, aaram ke waqt **left side** letein, aur paani peete rahein. Apne doctor ki salah ke bina diuretic/"paani ki goli" na lein.

question: Pregnancy me acidity, gas ya seene me jalan hone par kya gharelu upaay kar sakte hain?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein acidity, gas aur seene ki jalan (heartburn) common ho sakti hai. Aap ye safe steps try kar sakti hain:

- Din mein **4–5 chhote meals** lein; ek baar mein bahut zyada na khayen.
- Teekha, tala hua, bahut fatty/junk food, packaged snacks, achar, mithai aur fizzy drinks se bachne ki koshish karein agar in se jalan badhti ho.
- Tea/coffee **2 cups per day se zyada na lein**, aur meals ke saath na lein.
- Paani aur anya safe fluids paryapt lein; din bhar thoda-thoda karke piyen.
- Khana khane ke turant baad na leten; sone se pehle heavy meal na lein. Sote waqt sir/upper body thoda uncha rakhna madad kar sakta hai.
- Fresh, achchhi tarah paka hua khana khayen. Bacha hua khana sahi tareeke se reheat karke hi lein.

**Doctor/health centre se jaldi baat karein** agar jalan bahut zyada ho, baar-baar ho ya in upaayon se theek na ho; ulti ke kaaran kuchh kha-pi na paa rahi hon; tez pet ya seene mein dard, saans ki takleef, behoshi/zyada kamzori, bukhar, vaginal bleeding ya paani jaisa discharge ho. Baby ki movements kam lagen to bhi turant assessment karayen.

Pregnancy mein bina doctor ki salah ke acidity ki dawa, antacid ya koi herbal/gharelu nuskha na lein.

question: Agar doodh pilate samay nipple me dard ho ya wo chhil jaayein to kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
Nipple mein dard ya chhilna/cracks aksar **baby ka latch shallow hone** ki wajah se hota hai—jab baby sirf nipple pakadta hai aur areola (nipple ke aas-paas ka kala hissa) muh mein achchhe se nahi leta.

- Feeding ke waqt baby ko bilkul paas rakhein, uska body aapki taraf ho, aur **nose nipple ke saamne** ho.
- Baby ka muh wide open ho; baby ko nipple ke saath **areola ka achchha hissa** bhi muh mein lene dein. Lower lip bahar ki taraf ho aur chin breast ko touch kare.
- Feed mein dard ho to latch ko gently todkar dobara deep latch karayein. Zarurat par trained health worker/lactation counsellor se latch check karwayein.
- Nipple par apna thoda breast milk laga kar hawa mein sookhne dein. Harsh soap ya rubbing se bachayein.
- Cracks ke bawajood, agar aap manage kar paa rahi hain, breastfeeding usually jaari rakhi ja sakti hai with corrected latch. Agar feed karana bahut painful ho, milk express karke **saaf cup aur spoon** se baby ko diya ja sakta hai.

Sahi position aur latch se soreness aam taur par kuchh din mein behtar hoti hai. **Jaldi doctor/qualified health worker se milen** agar bukhar, breast mein laalpan/garmahat/soojan, peep, bahut tez dard, bleeding, ya 2–3 din mein sudhar na ho.

question: Main kaise pata karun ki mere bachche ka vajan aur lambai uski umar ke hisaab se theek hai ya nahi?
CompiledAnswer:
Bachche ka vajan aur lambai/height **umar aur ladka/ladki hone ke hisaab se WHO growth chart** par compare karke dekha jata hai.

Sahi check ke liye yeh details chahiye:
- exact umar (months mein, khaaskar chhote bachchon ke liye)
- ladka ya ladki
- current weight (kg)
- length/height (cm)

Health worker/doctor chart par aam taur par yeh dekhta hai:
1. **Weight-for-age**
2. **Length/height-for-age**
3. **Weight-for-length/height**

**2 saal se chhote** bachche ki length litaakar maapi jati hai; **2 saal ya usse bade** bachche ki height khada karke maapi jati hai. Ek hi reading se final faisla nahi hota—pichhle measurements ke saath growth ka trend dekhna bhi zaroori hai.

Aap is format mein details de sakte hain: **“Mera bachcha 18 mahine ka ladka/ladki hai, weight 9 kg aur length/height 78 cm hai.”** Isse growth chart par behtar assessment ho sakta hai.

Agar bachcha bilkul weight nahi badha raha, weight kam ho raha hai, bahut kam kha/pee raha hai, baar-baar bimar ho raha hai, ya sust lag raha hai, to jaldi health worker ya doctor ko dikhayein.

question: Aspataal me delivery karana ghar par delivery se behtar aur surakshit kyu hai?
CompiledAnswer:
### Aspataal mein delivery zyada surakshit kyon hoti hai?

Aspataal/health facility mein delivery isliye zyada surakshit hoti hai kyunki labour aur janm ke dauran maa ya baby ki problem kabhi bhi achanak shuru ho sakti hai. Wahan trained doctors, nurses aur zaroori equipment turant milte hain.

- **Emergency care jaldi milta hai:** Zyada bleeding, lamba ya ruk gaya labour, high BP/fits, baby ki heartbeat ki problem, ya breathing problem jaise complications ka turant ilaaj ho sakta hai.
- **Maa aur baby dono ki monitoring hoti hai:** Staff labour ke dauran maa ki condition aur baby ki heartbeat dekhte rehte hain.
- **Zarurat par operation ya referral:** Caesarean delivery, blood, medicines, newborn resuscitation, ya higher hospital referral ki zarurat ho to care mein deri kam hoti hai.
- **Janm ke turant baad newborn care:** Baby ko turant sukha kar garam rakhna, skin-to-skin care, pehle 1 ghante mein breastfeeding shuru karana, aur chhote/saans ya feeding problem wale baby ko special care mil sakti hai.
- **Teekakaran aur counselling:** BCG, OPV zero dose aur Hepatitis B jaise birth-dose vaccines, breastfeeding aur newborn-care guidance mil sakti hai.
- **Sarkari suvidhayein:** Sarkari health facilities mein JSSK ke tahat delivery, dawa, tests, stay, khana aur transport jaise muft benefits mil sakte hain. Apne area mein available services ki jankari ASHA/health worker se lein.

Delivery ki planning pregnancy ke dauran hi ASHA, ANM ya doctor ke saath karein, khas kar agar pehle C-section, high BP, diabetes, twins, bleeding, ya koi aur risk ho. Labour shuru ho, bleeding ho, paani jaldi nikal jaye, tez pet dard/fits aaye, ya baby ki movement kam lage to turant health facility se sampark karein. question: Main kaise samjhun ki mere bachche ko bhookh lagi hai aur uska pet bhar gaya hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Bhookh ke signs
Agar aapka baby doodh peeta hai, to bhookh ke early signs dekhein:
- haath ya mutthi munh mein lana
- lips lick karna, sucking movements karna, ya munh kholna
- godi mein lene par breast/bottle ki taraf head turn karna (rooting)
- fussiness ya bechaini

**Rona bhookh ka late sign hai**, isliye possible ho to rone se pehle feed offer karein.

## Pet bharne ke signs
Baby aam taur par pet bharne par:
- breast/bottle se khud hat jata hai ya sucking slow/stop kar deta hai
- relaxed, calm aur content dikhta hai
- feed ke baad neend mein chala sakta hai

Baby ko force-feed na karein. Agar woh ek breast ke baad bhi hunger cues dikhaye, to doosra breast offer kar sakte hain.

## Agar baby 6 mahine ya usse bada hai aur solids leta hai
Dheere aur patiently khilayein. Bhookh par munh kholna, food ki taraf lean karna ya haath badhana ho sakta hai; pet bharne par munh band karna, head turn karna, food push away karna ya interest khona ho sakta hai. Zabardasti na khilayein.

## Kab advice leni chahiye

question: 6 se 12 mahine ke bachche ko din me kitni baar aur kitna khilana chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
### 6–12 mahine ke bachche ko complementary food kitna aur kitni baar dein?

Agar bachcha healthy hai aur 6 mahine ke baad solids/complementary food shuru kar raha hai:

- **6–8 mahine:** din mein **2–3 baar** thick mashed/pureed ya semi-solid khana dein. Shuru mein **2–3 tablespoons** se start karein aur bachche ki bhookh ke hisaab se dheere-dheere badhayein.
- **9–11 mahine:** din mein **3 meals + 1–2 healthy snacks** dein. Har meal lagbhag **½ katori/cup (125 mL)** ho sakta hai. Khana mashed, finely chopped, ya soft finger foods ho sakta hai.
- **12 mahine ke aas-paas:** **3–4 meals + 1–2 snacks** dein. Portion bachche ki bhookh aur growth ke hisaab se badhayein; aam taur par **¾–1 katori/cup tak** ho sakta hai.

**Breastfeeding** (ya doctor-advised milk feeds) jaari rakhein; breastfeeding bachche ki demand par 2 saal ya usse zyada tak chal sakti hai. Bachche ko aaram se, patiently khilayein—force-feed na karein. Agar bachcha khana bilkul na kha raha ho, baar-baar ulti ho, weight na badh raha ho, ya feeding mein dikkat ho, to pediatrician se baat karein.

question: Agar naye paida hue bachche ko peeliya (jaundice) ho jaaye to kya karna chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Naye paida hue bachche mein peeliya

Agar baby ki **skin ya aankhen peeli** dikh rahi hain, to **aaj hi doctor/health worker ko dikhakar jaundice check karayein**. Newborns mein peeliya kabhi-kabhi common hota hai, lekin bilirubin level dekhna zaroori hota hai aur kuch babies ko treatment ki zarurat pad sakti hai.

- **Breastfeeding band na karein**; baby ko baar-baar, demand par feed karayein (aam taur par 24 ghante mein 8–12 feeds).
- **Sirf dhoop, gharelu nuskhe, paani, ghutti ya honey se treatment na karein.**
- Baby ko **turant/emergency care** ke liye le jayein agar peeliya janm ke pehle 24 ghante mein dikhe, jaldi badh raha ho, baby doodh kam pee raha ho, bahut sust ho, bukhar ho, saans tez chal rahi ho, bahut kamzor lage, ya fits/fainting ho.

Doctor ko baby ki **umar (din mein)**, feeding, bukhar, activity, aur yellowing kab se dikh rahi hai—yeh zaroor batayein.

question: Agar bachcha bimaar hai, jaise sardi ya dast, to kya use teeka lagwa sakte hain?

question: Agar maa ko sardi-bukhaar ho to kya woh bachche ko apna doodh pila sakti hai?
CompiledAnswer:
Haan—agar maa ko **aam sardi, khansi ya halka bukhaar** hai, to aam taur par breastfeeding **jaari rakh sakti hain**. Maa ke doodh se bachche ko protective antibodies milte hain. **Doctor se jaldi baat karein** agar bukhaar zyada ho ya 2–3 din se bana rahe, saans ki takleef ho, bahut kamzori/dehydration ho, koi specific infection (jaise COVID, flu, dengue, TB) diagnose ho, ya baby newborn/premature/बीमार ho.

question: Pregnancy me kam se kam kitni baar doctor se check-up karana anivarya hai?
CompiledAnswer:
## Pregnancy check-ups

Routine pregnancy mein **minimum 4 antenatal check-ups (ANC visits)** commonly advised kiye jaate hain:

1. **12 weeks ke andar** – pregnancy register karayein aur pehla check-up.
2. **16–24 weeks**
3. **28–32 weeks**
4. **36–38 weeks**

Ye schedule **normal, uncomplicated pregnancy** ke liye hai. High-risk pregnancy, diabetes/BP, anemia, twins, ya kisi problem mein doctor/health provider zyada visits bula sakte hain.

**Danger signs**—bleeding, tez pet dard, severe headache, chehre/haath-pair mein achanak sujan, bukhar, fits, ya baby movement kam lagna—mein next routine visit ka wait na karein; turant health facility se sampark karein.

> Note: ANC-contact recommendations guideline aur location ke hisaab se badal sakti hain; apne local government health programme/doctor ka schedule follow karein.

question: Delivery ke baad maa ko apne shareer ki dekhbhaal kaise karni chahiye?
CompiledAnswer:
## Delivery ke baad maa ki dekhbhaal

Delivery ke baad shareer ko theek hone ke liye **aaraam, poshtik khana, paani aur family support** chahiye—khaaskar pehle 28 din mein.

- **Aaraam karein:** Zyada bhaari kaam aur weight uthana shuru mein avoid karein. Ghar ke kaam aur baby care mein family se madad lein.
- **Poshtik khana khayein:** Dal, anda/maans (agar lete hain), doodh ya dairy, sabzi, फल, whole grains aur pulses shamil karein. Breastfeeding ke dauran extra nutritious food ki zaroorat hoti hai.
- **Paani aur fluids:** Pyaas ke hisaab se paryapt paani, doodh, soup ya anya safe fluids lein; aam taur par 2 litre ya usse zyada fluids din bhar mein madadgar ho sakte hain.
- **Kabz se bachav:** Whole grains, dal, sabzi aur fruits jaise fibre-rich foods khayein.
- **Iron–folic acid:** Doctor/ASHA/ANM ki salah ke mutabik IFA tablets lein. Kai public-health programmes mein delivery ke baad 100 din tak roz **100 mg elemental iron + 500 mcg folic acid** diya jata hai.
- **Breastfeeding:** Baby ko jaldi aur baar-baar breastfeed karayein, agar maa aur baby ki condition theek ho. Isse uterus ko sikudne mein madad milti hai aur bleeding kam ho sakti hai.
- **Safai aur follow-up:** Normal delivery ya C-section ke wound/stitches ko saaf aur sukha rakhein; prescribed postnatal check-ups par zaroor jayein.

### Turant doctor se sampark karein agar
Bahut zyada bleeding ho, bade clots aaye, bukhar ho, badbudar discharge ho, tez pet/pelvic pain ho, saans phoolna ya chest pain ho, severe headache/blurred vision ho, C-section wound se pus aaye, ya bahut udaasi/ghabrahat ya khud ko nuksan pahunchane ke khayal aaye.

Normal delivery aur C-section ki care thodi alag ho sakti hai; symptoms hon to individual medical advice lein.

question: Pregnancy me khoon ki kami (anemia) se maa aur bachche par kya bura asar pad sakta hai?
CompiledAnswer:
Pregnancy mein **khoon ki kami (anemia)**—khaaskar agar zyada ho aur treatment na ho—maa aur baby dono ke liye risk badha sakti hai.

**Baby par mumkin asar:**
- Jaldi delivery (**preterm birth**)
- Kam janam wazan (**low birth weight**)
- Pregnancy/birth ke aas-paas baby loss ka badha hua risk, especially severe anemia mein
- Bachche ke brain, learning aur motor development par asar padne ka risk

**Maa par mumkin asar:**
- Zyada thakan, kamzori, chakkar ya saans phoolna
- Roz ke kaam/kaam karne ki capacity kam hona
- Body ki infection se ladne ki capacity par asar
- Delivery ke time khoon ki kami ko tolerate karna mushkil ho sakta hai

Antenatal visits mein **Hb (hemoglobin) test** zaroor karwayein aur iron/IFA ki salah follow karein. **Hb 7 g/dL se kam**, behoshi, bahut zyada saans phoolna, chest pain, ya tez dhadkan ho to jaldi health facility se assessment karwayein.

question: Kam vajan ke saath paida hue bachche (LBW) ki ghar par vishesh dekhbhaal kaise karein?
CompiledAnswer:
## LBW baby ki ghar par dekhbhaal

Kam vajan se paida hue baby ko ghar par **garam rakhna, baar-baar maa ka doodh dena, safai, aur danger signs par nazar** rakhna bahut zaroori hai. Yeh salah **stable baby** ke liye hai; discharge ke samay mili hospital/doctor ki feeding aur follow-up plan ko priority dein.

- **Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC):** Baby ko diaper aur cap pehna kar maa ya healthy caregiver ke bare chest par skin-to-skin rakhein. Caregiver jagta aur alert rahe. KMC shuru/seekhna hospital ya health worker se karein.
- **Sirf breast milk:** Baby ko din-raat frequently feed karayein—aksar 24 ghante mein **8–12 baar**. Agar baby latch/suck nahi kar pa raha, to maa ka nikala hua doodh cup, spoon ya paladai se **health worker ki salah ke mutabik** dein. Ghar par tube feeding khud na karein.
- **Baby ko warm rakhein:** Baby ko adult se 1–2 layers zyada kapde pehnayein aur sir dhak kar rakhein. Kapde sukhe rakhein; baby ko bahut garam bhi na karein.
- **Safai aur naal ki care:** Baby ko chhoone se pehle sabun se haath dhoyein. Naal/cord stump ko saaf aur sukha rakhein; uspar tel, powder, ointment ya koi gharelu cheez na lagayein.
- **Safe sleep:** Baby ko hamesha **peeth ke bal** sulayein, firm flat surface par. Takia, loose rajai/blanket aur soft toys na rakhein.
- **Weight aur follow-up:** Weight health worker ke schedule ke hisaab se check karayein. LBW baby ko regular follow-up ki zaroorat hoti hai.

### Turant health worker/hospital se sampark karein agar
- baby doodh bahut kam ya bilkul na pee raha ho;
- saans tez/pareshani wali ho, seena dhans raha ho, ya baby neela pad raha ho;
- baby bahut thanda/garam lage, bahut sust ho, jag na raha ho;
- jhatke/convulsions hon; ya koi bhi condition achanak bigad rahi ho.

Baby ki age, birth weight aur current weight, feeding, aur premature birth ki history doctor/ASHA/ANM ko batakar individualized plan lein.
